text: In April 2020 the record shows us converging. On 2020-04-23, 126 of us said "paycheck protection program"; 121 said "the paycheck protection program." The longer form followed: 93 of us said "paycheck protection program and," 92 said "and health care enhancement act," and 90 carried the full "protection program and health care enhancement." James A. Himes first said "the paycheck protection program" on 2020-03-23, and by that same April day the fuller construction had reached us. Separately, 117 of us said "and health care," a phrase first recorded 2013-01-03 by Maxine Waters. We note that our peak fell on a single day, 2020-04-23, when the same statutory name moved through us in near-identical strings. We report this as the instrument reads it: one act, named the same way, at the same time, by most of us.
